changes.from: RENAME: 'Yao Guang' (瑶光) is the name of a unit of Ti5's second-gen T170A humanoid launched at WAIC 4 Jul 2024 (maker news ti5robot.com/h-nd-39.html, read via search excerpt; page now 404). Maker release: 1.7 m, 48 kg, 44 DoF, 5 kg single-hand load, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB, LiDAR + binocular cameras. Maker's current English site (ti5robotics.com) lists T170A and newer T170A V2/T170C/T140A; a 2025 maker EN page (seen in excerpts) also cites dual-arm load 20-40 kg, five RealSense cameras, 6-mic array — newer config, not filled. Status left blank (superseded by T170A V2 likely).
changes.to: RENAME: 'Yao Guang' (瑶光) is the name of a unit of Ti5's second-gen T170A humanoid launched at WAIC 4 Jul 2024 (maker news ti5robot.com/h-nd-39.html, read via search excerpt; page now 404). Maker release: 1.7 m, 48 kg, 44 DoF, 5 kg single-hand load, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB, LiDAR + binocular cameras. Maker's current English site (ti5robotics.com) lists T170A and newer T170A V2/T170C/T140A; a 2025 maker EN page (seen in excerpts) also cites dual-arm load 20-40 kg, five RealSense cameras, 6-mic array — newer config, not filled. Status left blank (superseded by T170A V2 likely). Maker model page opened 2026-11-17 (ti5robotics.com .../T170A.html): 48 kg, 1.5 m arm span, 44 active DoF, 32 joint motors, single-arm load 3 kg, hand 6 active DoF (0.5 kg standard / 3 kg flagship), 18-bit encoders, 48 V 10 Ah battery, CAN/EtherCAT, dual-arm API; standard model Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB, flagship Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB dev kit + RealSense D435i + 2x six-axis force sensors. CONFLICT: the 2024 WAIC release (now 404) said 5 kg single-hand load; the current maker page says 3 kg single-arm, which is stored. Height 1.7 m comes from the T170A naming/2024 release; the current page's parameter table omits height. Note the maker site serves swapped pages (T170A-V2.html returns the T170A table), so page-to-model mapping was taken from the printed heading.
